verdict.rationale: The evidence shows notes are local plain-text Markdown files usable offline (obsidian-docs-2, obsidian-docs-20). The Bases core plugin provides database-like, query-driven views of notes (obsidian-docs-6), which community users describe as a faster replacement for Dataview queries (obsidian-comm-5); this implies some filtering of notes. Nothing in the pack documents the core capability, full-text search, or tag and path filters. Missing for 10: documented full-text search, explicit tag/property/path search filters, evidence of instant search speed, and hands-on corroboration of offline search.
